Gujarat 
Panchayats 
Act, 1993.
NOTIFICATION
Panchayats, Rural Housing and Rural Development Department
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar.
Dated the.....March, 2024 
 
No.KP/11 of 2024/PRHRDD/MSM/e-file/14/2023/0662/Section - J: - 
WHEREAS certain draft rules issued under sub-section (1) of section 65, sub-
section (1) of section 79, section 124, clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section
147 and clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 148 of the Gujarat Panchayats
Act, 1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993) were published as required by sub-section (5) of
section 274 of the said Act at pages 96 of the Gujarat Government Gazette,
PART I-A, Central Section dated the 28th December, 2023, under the
Government Notiﬁcation, Panchayats, Rural Housing and Rural Development
Department, No. KP/69 of 2023/PRHRDD/MSM/e-ﬁle/14/2023/0662/Section-J,
dated the 6th December, 2023 inviting objections and suggestions from all
persons likely to be aﬀected thereby within a period of thirty days from the
date of publication of the said notification in the Official Gazette; 
AND WHEREAS no objections or suggestions have been received in respect of
the said draft rules by the Government; 
NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of
section 65, sub-section (1) of section 79, section 124, clause (a) of sub-section
(1) of section 147 and clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 148 of the
Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat
hereby makes the following rules further to amend the Gujarat Panchayats
(Honorarium to officials) Rules, 1995, namely:-
1. These rules may be called the Gujarat Panchayats (Honorarium to oﬃcials)
(Amendment) Rules, 2024.
2. In the Gujarat Panchayats (Honorarium to oﬃcials) Rules, 1995
(hereinafter referred as "the said rules"), in rule 3,-
(1) in sr. no. (1), for the ﬁgures “2250”, the ﬁgures “10,000” shall be
substituted;
(2) in sr. no. (2), for the ﬁgures “3375”, the ﬁgures “15,000” shall be
substituted;
(3) in sr. no. (3), for the ﬁgures “1700”, the ﬁgures “7,500” shall be
substituted;
(4) in sr. no. (4), for the ﬁgures “2250”, the ﬁgures “10,000” shall be
substituted;
(5) in sr. no. (5), for the ﬁgures “2250”, the ﬁgures “10,000” shall be
substituted;
3. In the said rules, in rule 3, the following proviso shall be inserted, namely:- 
Letter No: PRHRDD/0211/03/2024   Dt: 11-03-2024
File No: PRHRDD/MSM/e-file/14/2023/0662/Section - J
Approved By: Principal Secretary,PRHRDD
Signed by:Simran Poptani
Deputy Secretary Incharge
Date: 2024.03.11 15:21:23
+05:30
Signature Not Verified

"Provided that the expense of Honorarium paid to the various oﬃcials of the
District Panchayats and Taluka Panchayat shall be made from the own funds

              By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat,
